study_identification_part.si3_author_journal_year: Young et al., Biological Psychiatry: Cognitive Neuroscience and Neuroimaging, 2024
study_identification_part.si4_title: Normative Modeling of Thalamic Nuclear Volumes and Characterization of Lateralized Volume Alterations in Alzheimer's Disease Versus Schizophrenia

cm1_research_objectives.reason: The study clearly states its objectives and the purpose of using normative modeling. It aims to establish normative models of thalamic nuclear volumes and investigate changes in Schizophrenia (SCZ) and Alzheimer's Disease (AD).
cm1_research_objectives.supporting_text: The aim of this work was to establish novel normative models of thalamic nuclear volumes and their laterality indices and investigate their changes in SCZ and AD... Therefore, we hypothesized that normative modeling of thalamic nuclear volumes would facilitate the identification of shared and distinct changes in thalamic nuclear regions between the 2 disorders.

nm1_selection_criteria_reference_cohort.reason: The study describes the eligibility criteria for the reference cohort by referencing the original datasets (e.g., HCP, ADNI) and providing details in the supplement. It also specifies image quality standards and reporting the final sample size.
nm1_selection_criteria_reference_cohort.supporting_text: Unprocessed T1-weighted images and clinical measures were accessed from 7 cohorts... described in Supplemental Methods... All subjects (n=628...) were defined as controls and considered to have a broadly typical development... Participants with missing or failed segmentations were reprocessed or excluded.

nm2_handling_of_covariates_reference_coh.reason: The study explicitly controlled for age, sex, intracranial volume (eTIV), and site. Site effects were addressed using ComBat or by including site as a covariate in multivariate models.
nm2_handling_of_covariates_reference_coh.supporting_text: Normative models for each nucleus were generated from healthy control participants while controlling for sex, intracranial volume, and site... site effects were mitigated with ComBat... or multivariate models that accounted for the effects of age, sex, TIV, and site.

nm3_data_sources_reference_cohort.supporting_text: Unprocessed T1-weighted images and clinical measures were accessed from 7 cohorts (HCP DEV, HCP EP, HCP YA, UCLA, SCZ AH, HCP AGE, and ADNI) described in Supplemental Methods.

nm5_data_preprocessing.reason: Preprocessing steps are described, including N4-bias correction, cropping, and the use of the HIPS-THOMAS segmentation method. Quality control procedures (visual inspection) are also described.
nm5_data_preprocessing.supporting_text: HIPS-THOMAS was shown to significantly improve accuracy... input T1 images are N4-bias corrected... automatically cropped... converted to WMn-like contrast... All segmentations were visually inspected...

nm6_internal_data_validation_reference_c.reason: A 5-fold cross-validation strategy was used to evaluate the normative models.
nm6_internal_data_validation_reference_c.supporting_text: A 5-fold crossvalidation was used to evaluate each model.

nm7_external_data_validation_reference_c.reason: The study used data from multiple cohorts to build the model using cross-validation (internal validation), but there is no mention of applying the final normative model to a completely independent external dataset of healthy individuals that was not used for model development.
nm7_external_data_validation_reference_c.supporting_text: The model with the best overall performance... was selected and trained on all control samples for each region.
